about_short_description.short_description: Fingo is a fintech startup that provides digital banking services for youth.

product.name: Personal Account
product.description: A digital bank account that allows users to perform transactions, manage finances, and access banking services via a mobile app.

product.name: Interest-Earning Savings
product.description: A savings account that offers up to 15% annual interest with daily compounding, allowing flexible deposits and withdrawals.

product.name: Virtual Pre-Paid Cards
product.description: Customizable virtual prepaid cards for secure online payments, with features to manage card status and spending.

product.name: Rewards Program
product.description: A loyalty system where users earn Fingo Coins for transactions and activities, redeemable for discounts, raffles, and other benefits.

product.name: Islamic Banking (Shariah-Compliant Banking)
product.description: Banking products and services that comply with Islamic finance principles, including interest-free savings and ethical financing.
